requirement: Write a ShoppingCart class with add_item(name, price, qty), remove_item(name), apply_percentage_discount(percent), and get_total(). Adding an item that already exists should increase its quantity rather than duplicate it. Removing an item that doesn't exist should raise a KeyError. The discount should only apply to the current total, not stack across multiple calls. get_total() should return 0 for an empty cart.

acceptance_criteria.text: add_item stores a new item with the specified name, price, and quantity
add_item increments the quantity of an existing item instead of creating a duplicate
remove_item deletes an existing item and raises KeyError when the item name is not in the cart
apply_percentage_discount reduces the current total by the given percent and does not compound when called multiple times
get_total returns the sum of price*quantity for all items minus any applied discount, and returns 0 when the cart is empty

tasks.description: Create ShoppingCart class with internal data structures
Implement add_item to add new items and increase quantity for existing items
Implement remove_item to delete items and raise KeyError if item not found
Implement apply_percentage_discount to apply a one-time discount to the current total
Implement get_total to compute total after discount and return 0 for empty cart
